method: Wash and dry the lettuce and tomato. Shred the lettuce and slice the tomato; put both on a clean plate, separate from the raw filling.
Split the wholemeal burger bun and toast the cut faces in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 1–2 minutes. Set it on a clean plate.
Mix the measured tomato ketchup and cider vinegar in a clean small bowl. Keep this finishing sauce separate from the uncooked filling.
Drain the firm tofu, pat it dry and cut it into slabs about 1cm thick to fit the bun. Coat with all the measured chilli powder and paprika. Use clean utensils for the cooked tofu.

Heat the measured olive oil in the non-stick frying pan. Cook the tofu slabs over a medium-high heat for about 4–5 minutes on each side, until golden and hot through. Follow any longer cooking instruction on the tofu pack.
Put the lettuce and tomato in the toasted bun, add the browned tofu slabs and the cold finishing sauce, then close the bun and serve immediately.
